culpritSource.quote: The case is actually murder, and the culprit is Seiko Kanbayashi. The Kanbayashis merely pretended to be happily married, but their life together has long since gone to shambles, and they have become interested in different partners. Chosaku had been hatching a plan to kill his wife to reap in her life insurance, but he wasn't aware that Seiko was trying to do away with him as well.

motive.zhHans: Kanbayashi夫妇只是假装婚姻幸福，他们的共同生活早已支离破碎，两人也都各自另寻新欢。Chosaku一直策划杀害妻子以骗取她的人寿保险，但他并不知道Seiko也在设法除掉他。

method.zhHans: Kanbayashi夫妇只是假装婚姻幸福，他们的共同生活早已支离破碎，两人也都各自另寻新欢。接着他会假装离开办公室去买香烟，然后进入相邻大楼，打开五楼一间浴室的窗户。回到办公室（以获得目击证词）之后，他打算从自己所在的大楼跳进隔壁的浴室，在公园里截住必定会路过的Seiko并将其勒死。然后他会原路返回交出稿件，同样有目击者，从而巩固自己的不在场证明。然而，就在他为妻子的谋杀案制造不在场证明期间，Seiko（带着执行自己谋杀计划的意图）提前到达，发现Chosaku举止反常，识破了他的企图。Seiko稍后返回，并以Chosaki办公室大楼的门卫作为她不在场证明的目击证人，装作第一个发现尸体的人。
method.en: The Kanbayashis merely pretended to be happily married, but their life together has long since gone to shambles, and they have become interested in different partners. Then he would pretend to leave his office for cigarettes, then go into the neighboring building to open a bathroom window on the fifth floor. After returning to his office (for an eyewitness testimony), he intended to jump from his building into the bathroom next door, intercept Seiko in the park which she was sure to walk through, and strangle her. Then he would return the same way and deliver his manuscript, again with an eyewitness, thus consolidating his own alibi. While on the works to provide his alibi for his wife's murder, however, Seiko (with the intention to carry out her own murder plan) arrived early, spotted Chosaku behaving strangely, and realised what he was up to. Seiko returned later and pretended - with the doorman of Chosaku's office building as her alibi witness - to be the first discoverer.

evidence.zhHans: 她的罪行得以证实，是因为在她杀害丈夫的那间浴室里发现了她的头发，以及Chosaku的眉毛毛发夹杂在刷子的鬃毛之中。
evidence.en: Her crime could be proven thanks to her hair being found in the bathroom from where she killed her husband, and Chosaku's eyebrow hairs among the bristles of the brush.
